Pannello.Ridimensiona: Unlock resizing (handle at the bottom right)
Pannello.ManigliaAiuto: Drag to enlarge or shrink the panel

Gestore.Vuoto: No clocks yet. Create one with the button above.
Gestore.EliminaTesto: The clock "{titolo}" and its events will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

Config.SegmentiAiuto: Each segment can have a name and a list of events. Events fire when the segment fills.
Config.SoloNarratoreAiuto: Only game masters receive the message
Config.GuidaBase: These four things are enough to start the clock. Color and options are under Look, names and events of single segments under Segments.
Config.GuidaSegmenti: Optional. Each segment can have a name, its own timer (replacing the base one) and a list of events that fire when the segment fills.
Config.GuidaSegmentiSenzaTimer: Optional. Each segment can have a name and a list of events that fire when you move it forward.

Campi.DurataAiuto: Applies to every segment. When it runs out the segment fills and the next one starts. A segment can have its own timer under Segments.
Campi.CicloAiuto: (restart from zero after a full turn; otherwise stop when full)
Campi.ManualeScatena: Events also fire on manual advance
Campi.TitoloSegnaposto: E.g. The night of the ritual
Campi.UnitaAiuto: Names the segments without writing a name for each: "Scene 1", "Scene 2"…
Campi.DimensioneAiuto: How big the pie is in the panel.
Campi.TimerProprioAiuto: Timer for this segment, instead of the base one. Empty: base timer.
Campi.SenzaTimer: No timer: advances by hand only
Campi.SenzaTimerAiuto: No countdown: segments move forward and back only on your commands, and events fire as you step through.

Avvisi.EventoFallito: Clock "{titolo}": an event of segment {segmento} failed. Check the console.
